verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one version of the MCP docs stating the hosted MCP server exposes 'calendar tools' alongside inbox and message tools. Other captures of the same page omit calendar, and nothing documents what those tools do. Calendar features are a fair axis for an email provider, so this thin first-party mention earns minimal partial credit. Missing for 10: documented ability to view a calendar, respond to invites, and create events; any in-client (console or email client) calendar UI; details of the calendar tool set; independent or hands-on corroboration.
